page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the ecs.re6 family, virtualized via KVM. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 8 physical Intel Xeon 8269CL cores running at 2.5 GHz, with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 16 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance tradeoff. Single-core processing capabilities are relatively limited, with stress-ng single-core CPU performance, Geekbench single-core scores, and single-threaded compression tests all ranking in the bottom 25%. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, as demonstrated by middle-tier results in stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory subsystem performance is also average, with read-only and write large-block memory bandwidth benchmarks falling into the middle 50% tier.

Given the high memory density relative to the compute resources, this server type offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads that do not require high single-threaded CPU performance. The 256.0 GB memory capacity makes it appropriate for hosting in-memory databases, caching layers such as Redis, and database operations, where average multi-core throughput and memory bandwidth are sufficient. It is also applicable for static web serving and general-purpose enterprise applications requiring large memory footprints without intensive single-core compute demands.
